title: School board bans AI for all FCPS students
key_facts: The Frederick County school board voted 6-1 on Wednesday, 7 Oct 2026, to ban AI for students in all grades.
The vote came after the board heard from some Frederick County Public Schools teachers.
Aubrey Lynch, a teacher at Urbana High School, advocated a full AI ban for students at the school board meeting.
The text we could read is mostly subscription and newsletter boilerplate; the vote and the teachers' comments are the only news in it.
The article text we could read gives no detail on how the ban will be applied or enforced.
